With a top cruising speed of 300 kilometers per hour and a range of up to 400 kilometers, the CE-25A employs advanced distributed electric propulsion technology, signaling a new era for electric flight.

Redefining boundaries will necessitate constitutional amendments, and a potential referendum may follow, pending parliamentary consent.

title: 80 years after genocide convention, Myanmar faces historic ICJ verdict

This pivotal decision, initiated by The Gambia in 2019, could reshape international law on genocide accountability. Moreover, South Africa has launched a similar case against Israel's actions in Gaza. The upcoming ruling may offer vital insights into assessing genocidal intent in current legal disputes.

title: UP cop dies by suicide by jumping before train; woman held over blackmail
description: Sandeep Kumar, a 28-year-old police sub-inspector, died by suicide near Nagpur after being blackmailed. He had been in an extramarital relationship with a woman named Roli Gond from Sikandarpur. Kumar's wife has lodged a complaint leading to Gond's arrest for abetting the suicide. The police investigation revealed Kumar had a six-month-old child and was recently transferred to Pakri police station.

title: Arshdeep Singh & Co. swing it India's way to secure 3-1 series win vs New Zealand
description: India achieved a 22-run victory against New Zealand in the final ODI match. The match saw a fierce bowling effort, leading to crucial wickets at important moments. Mohammed Siraj, Yash Thakur, and Axar Patel played significant roles in the victory. This win allowed India to win the series 3-1, strengthening their position in white-ball cricket. The team's relentless approach was evident throughout the match, culminating in an impressive win.

title: Delhi Moti Nagar murder: Man suspected of murdering 18-year-old apprehended
description: A 29-year-old suspect named Suraj has been arrested concerning the murder of an 18-year-old saleswoman named Shabnam. Shabnam was discovered dead in a trial room at Vastr Mahal in Moti Nagar, where she worked. Preliminary investigations suggest a personal connection might have led to the crime. Police recovered evidence, including a blood-stained knife, during their investigation.

title: Yemeni forces withdraw from Bab el-Mandeb as Houthis cement foothold
description: In a significant development, Saudi backed Yemeni forces have declared their withdrawal from the critical Bab el-Mandeb area, ceding control to the Houthis. This manoeuvre is aimed at bolstering security in Aden and surrounding areas. With the Houthis ramping up aggression towards southern regions, concerns have emerged over the impact on global shipping routes. The withdrawal follows a previously established truce that has now collapsed amidst renewed violence.

title: A collective batting surrender! How the mighty fell in New Zealand

No Indian batter scored 100 runs across the five-match ODI series; Virat Kohli’s 86 was the highest. Coach Gautam Gambhir warned the failures raise concerns for the ODI World Cup in South Africa next year.

description: A Canadian woman traveled to Delhi on a tourist visa after establishing an online connection with a potential husband. Their meeting in Neemrana, Rajasthan, took a turn when the man hesitated about marriage upon discovering her age. This led to a conflict, prompting the intervention of local authorities after she reached out to the Canadian embassy.

title: 'Pakistan a soft target': Manjrekar questions India's aggressive celebrations
description: Sanjay Manjrekar has weighed in on the celebrations of India's Under-19 cricket team following their thrilling victory in the Asia Cup final against Pakistan. With India clinching the match by just one wicket in a nail-biting finish, he remarked that the team should consider facing tougher opponents to truly reflect their competitive spirit. This opens up a dialogue about sportsmanship and the nature of post-victory celebrations.

She questioned the delay in addressing their families' concerns, saying officials acted only after intervention from the Lieutenant Governor. Two suspects, Mahakdeep Kaur and Davinder Singh, were arrested in Gurdaspur, Punjab, for this attack. Investigations revealed that a Pakistan-based handler exploited a romantic relationship to recruit Mahakdeep for the operation. The Rajasthan Anti-Terrorism Squad conducted extensive investigations, including analyzing call records and tracing leads.

title: From kidneys to body tissues: Desperate Iranians put organs up for sale as war drags on

An Iran International investigation of over 600 Telegram listings found widespread multiple-organ offers, highlighting growing financial desperation. The crisis is worsening amid US sanctions, a naval blockade and regional conflict. Economists warn prolonged restrictions could severely affect oil revenues, inflation, public salaries and essential supplies, despite Tehran rejecting economic collapse concerns.

The historic event took place at SpaceX’s Starbase in Texas following the spacecraft's successful re-entry. Starship had completed 14 laps around Earth and deployed advanced Starlink satellites during its flight. Despite the success, a first-stage booster explosion occurred shortly after liftoff during the tests.

Witnesses noted that the man appeared to be extremely hungry and potentially mentally unstable. After being approached, the man fled the scene, but local residents provided him with food.
